# dsh-plugin-git-commits
English | 中文
A DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds a **Git commits** entry to the Web UI sidebar. Browse commit his
tory, compare file diffs, stage and commit your changes, and sync, pull, or push the current branch
— without leaving the app.
## Features
### Changes tab
- Files grouped into **Staged** and **Unstaged** (including untracked), with `A` `M` `D` `R` `U` bad

ges and `+n / -n` counts
- Toggle staging per file, or stage/unstage everything from the group heade

r
- Side-by-side diff with line numbers: worktree vs index, index vs HEAD; untracked files render as

new-file diffs
- Commit box: `⌘/Ctrl + Enter` commits, and only staged changes are committed; the b

utton shows the file count
- **Sync** runs `git fetch --all --prune` and shows `↓n` (behind) / `↑n`

(ahead) badges
- **Pull ↓n** integrates the incoming commits, with rebase (default) or merge, `--aut

ostash` so uncommitted work is preserved
- **Push** publishes the branch; the first push sets the up

stream with `-u origin HEAD`
- Every remote write asks for confirmation first
- When a pull conflict
s, a red banner lists the conflicted files and offers **Abort merge** (`git rebase --abort` / `merge
anner lists the conflicted files and offers **Abort merge** (`git rebase --abort` / `merge --abort`)
### History tab

- Commit list with short hash, author, date, and subject, paged with **Load more**
- Per-commit file
list, and a unified diff with line numbers, green additions, red deletions, and highlighted hunk he
, and a unified diff with line numbers, green additions, red deletions, and highlighted hunk headers

| Half | File | Role |
| Host | `index.js` | Read route `/git-commits-api` (resource, GET/HEAD) and write route `/git-commi

ts-write` (raw handler, POST) |
| Client | `client.js` | `sidebar.footer.action` trigger button and

`shell.overlay` drawer panel |
| Display | `locale/*.json`, `icon.svg` | Plugin Manager title, descr

awer panel |
| Display | `locale/*.json`, `icon.svg` | Plugin Manager title, description, and icon |

`fetch` returns `ahead`, `behind`, and `incoming` (the commits the remote has that the local branch
does not). A failed `pull` returns `conflicts`, the conflicted file paths.
## Safety
- Commands only ever run in workspaces registered with `workspaceRegistry` (plus the profile's defau

lt directory). Any other path is rejected with 403.
- File paths must be repository-relative: absolu

te paths, `..`, and leading `-` are all refused.
- Write requests must be same-origin (`Origin` must

match `Host`); reads accept only GET and HEAD.
- Every `git` invocation goes through an argv array,

never a shell. Writes time out after 120s, reads after 20s.
- Pushing rewrites a remote branch and
pulling rewrites the working tree, so both ask for confirmation. Pulling uses `--autostash` to prote

ct uncommitted changes.
- A failed pull leaves the repository in a conflicted state; **Abort merge**
returns it to where it was before the pull.
